name: AgentFail
description: AgentFail is a dataset and benchmark for diagnosing failure root causes in platform-orchestrated agentic systems. It contains 307 annotated failure logs with a taxonomy of root causes and evaluates LLMs' ability to automatically identify these causes, highlighting the challenge of this task.
reputation: A small, recent diagnostic benchmark with limited but growing interest for agent failure analysis.
notes: Includes a taxonomy and uses counterfactual reasoning for annotation reliability.
